## Release validation

Built from `b3fe71026d8261d386c6f16fcdeb1596ebb85942`. Native Linux ARM64 packaging and acceptance tests passed in [qt-ci run 40598756074](https://github.com/OpenCloudGaming/OpenNOW/actions/runs/40598756074).

All 30 published files were downloaded and checked after publication. The complete inventory, all 14 Ed25519 package/sidecar manifests, 29 SHA-256 checksums, and the release tag's exact source commit passed verification against the repository's pinned public key.

These nightlies have no Windows Authenticode certificate or Apple Developer ID signature and are not notarized. Signed update manifests authenticate downloads; they do not remove SmartScreen or Gatekeeper warnings. Do not disable platform security checks globally.

**Known issue: Alliance Partners are not working correctly in this build.**

## Validation limits

Physical-GPU Wayland/Vulkan window-lifecycle validation was not performed for this release. The maintainer explicitly chose to proceed with automated checks and community issue reports. The cloud software-rendering probe encountered hide/teardown instability with both the changed and unchanged code; this does not establish a GPU-driver root cause.

CI does not establish live hardware decoding, HDR/color accuracy, Windows ARM64 runtime behavior, or installed SteamOS/DroidDeck compatibility. Report problems with the OpenNOW version, OS, desktop/compositor, GPU, driver and graphics backend.

Existing recording limitation: audio and video tracks independently discard their initial offsets. The real-world synchronization impact and a safe shared-timestamp correction remain unmeasured.

name: OpenNOW v1.0.3
body:
OpenNOW 1.0.3 
## Highlights

- **Who's playing?** Keep several accounts signed in, pick one at launch and switch without leaving the app. (#1174)
- **DLSS for your plan.** Cloud DLSS overrides, DLSS labels from NVIDIA's DLSS games list, and DLSS support per membership tier in game details. (#1215, #1227, #1230)
- **Ctrl+G drawer.** Now docked left, with quick toggles, Anti-AFK and per-controller tuning. (#1183, #1179)
- **Smarter game tiles.** Launchers, RTX, HDR, Reflex, DLSS and membership locks at a glance. (#1220)
- **Game Mode redesign.** A rebuilt console experience for controllers and TVs. (#1120)
- **First-run setup.** Guided onboarding with one decision per step. (#1159)
- **Updates.** A Settings › Updates page, a status-bar update chip and real download progress. (#1212)
- **HOTAS, flight controls and wheels.** Passed through to the game as the real device. (#1187)
- **Alliance Partners.** Alliance accounts stream correctly again. (#1098, #1162)

## Streaming and reliability

- Store versions without HDR stream in SDR, with a single notice per game. (#1232)
- Codec, chroma and HDR fall back the way GeForce NOW does instead of failing the launch. (#1165)
- Native WebRTC compatibility mode. (#1089)
- Faster recovery from packet loss with reference-frame invalidation. (#1164, #1147, #1167)
- Smoother audio with bounded jitter buffering. (#1170, #1192)
- Session time is kept across reconnects. (#1208)

## Platforms and accounts

- **Linux:** x64 and arm64 Flatpaks, VA-API and V4L2 decode fixes, and steadier PipeWire audio. (#1121, #1213, #1189, #1100, #1207, #1134)
- **macOS:** opt-in AWDL suppression while streaming. (#1177)
- **Accounts:** GOG linking. (#1206)
- **Reporting:** automatic bug reports, which you can turn off. (#1092)

## Downloads

| Platform | Packages |
| --- | --- |
| Windows x64 and ARM64 | `-setup.exe` installer, `.msi`, portable `.zip` |
| macOS, Apple Silicon (macOS 13+) | `.dmg`, `.zip` |
| Linux x64 and arm64 | `.AppImage`, `.deb`, `.flatpak` |

## Install notes

- **macOS:** Developer ID-signed and notarized. Intel Macs are not included in this release.
- **Windows:** signing follows the candidate's `windowsSigningMode` in `RELEASE-INFO.json`. Unsigned packages may trigger SmartScreen. ARM64 is cross-built and not runtime-tested by CI.
- **AppImage:** make the file executable before launching. It embeds update information and ships a `.zsync` sidecar for external delta-update tools.
- **DEB:** bundles Qt and SDL3. Install with `sudo apt install ./OpenNOW-Qt-1.0.3-Linux-x64.deb` (use arm64 on ARM systems) so apt pulls in system dependencies, including pkexec for update authorization.
- **Flatpak:** install with `flatpak install --user ./OpenNOW-Qt-1.0.3-Linux-x64.flatpak` (use arm64 on ARM systems). Flatpak manages its own updates; the in-app updater does not.

## Known issues

- YUV 4:4:4 is marked Coming soon because it does not work correctly yet. Use a 4:2:0 color profile.

## Build

Source commit: `60ce69a07bf94ba484af7406d386ccb28e5a13e6`. Production candidate run: `38824556678`. CI passing covers builds and tests; it does not imply hardware-specific gameplay acceptance.
